author: shadowolfyt
body:
Hey Everyone
I feel that Avicus never uses there YouTube Channel I think it should be used! I don't know how it would be used? But I think it should be used as a community channel to post Avicus Network content.
I am currently coming up with ideas of how to use the Avicus Network YouTube Channel and how we can use it to advertise.

Suggestions & Ideas?
